instagram.caption:
The second machine.
The Beverage or Coffee Station in the Dining Room. Make a drink and hand it over without crossing into the kitchen.

What done looks like:
1. Sugar running left to right along one liftable tray
2. Mugs capped at the number of daily drinkers plus two
3. A marked fill line on the bean jar
4. A hand's width of clear air behind the kettle
